aggregate.pooling: No pooled-frame mean, percentile, significance test, or confidence interval. Statistics are retained per process; cross-process medians/ranges describe only three repetitions.

telemetry.scope: Whole process lifetime, including startup/loading/warmup/capture/teardown; capture window is not explicitly delimited in these CSVs.
telemetry.competitionDefinition: Windows GPU Engine counters: only valid individual engine samples >= 0.1 percent are exported. Peaks are per engine; values are not summed or treated as whole-card utilization. Benchmark process was absent, so attribution is partial.

timingDefinitions.frameTime: Start-to-start editor loop, includes waits, events, recording, submit, present and capture bookkeeping.
timingDefinitions.gpuTime: Inclusive named scopes; RenderGraph envelope excludes editor composite/present and independent texture submissions.
timingDefinitions.loadingSeconds: First scene-ready observation minus loading draw-loop start, after loadBuiltInSample; excludes subsequent 10 s warmup and earlier app/setup work.
timingDefinitions.telemetry: Whole-runtime approximately 1 Hz sampled card and background-engine data, not capture-window-isolated.

limitations: Standalone baseline, not bake A/B; old baseline resolution differs, so no bake speedup claim.
Only three fresh processes; frame counts are not independent repeated experiments.
Cache state was neither reset nor measured; shader/OS caches may be warm.
Hidden-window route; validation disabled, no screenshot-based visual verification.
Telemetry CSV has no explicit capture-window marker; benchmark process absent from GPU Engine records, attribution partial.
Asset launch-time size/timestamp recorded without a content hash; measured raster SPIR-V fingerprint is stable.
Named pool memory does not represent all renderer allocations, and whole-card memory includes background processes.
comparisonScope: Current revision4 production live path at 2560x1440 output; no bake-only A/B or previous-resolution speedup claim
